charts.title: K2-126 b: orbits around K2-126
charts.description: The orbits of K2-126's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-126 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kruse et al. 2019 (2019ApJS..244...11K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KRUSE_ET_AL__2019): P 7.38711 d
